title: Riven Tides update - Reclaim the coast
body:
# Riven Tides update - Reclaim the coast

Raiders,

Scout reports have been coming back from Riven Tides. Fragments of observation logs, faded photographs, and coastal footage have finally made their way back to Speranza.

Now it's your turn to see it firsthand. Explore the abandoned shoreline, move through the Exodus port, and take in the lost luxury of the Panorama Azzurro hotel.

This is the Rust Belt, so expect a fight. Other Raiders are already chasing fresh loot, and a new floating ARC machine has been spotted patrolling the skies. Its purpose, and how to deal with it, is something you'll have to work out on your own.

# NEW MAP: RIVEN TIDES

A stretch of deserted shoreline sits on the western coast of the Rust Belt. This place has been abandoned twice: first during the Exodus, then again by First Wave survivors who couldn't hold the exposed settlement against ARC. From the fading resort to the towering dockyard, claim your ground and see what treasures are waiting.

# NEW ENEMY: ARC TURBINE

Set against a sunset, the **ARC Turbine** almost looks beautiful as it drifts across the Rust Belt. It seems calm, docile, and quiet, right up until you get close. Nobody knows exactly what it's for, but interfering with it means preparing for a completely unique fight. Its defensive abilities are brutal, presenting a new challenge that demands skill, patience, and steady nerves.

# NEW MINOR MAP CONDITION: BEACHCOMBING

Riven Tides adds a new minor map condition called **Beachcombing**. Watch for the **Dockmaster's Detector** during a session and sweep it across the sand to reveal loot buried beneath the surface. What turns up will vary, but the best hunting grounds tend to be out in the open.

# NEW ITEMS: CRASH MAT AND POWERED DESCENDER

Traveling from A to B is rarely simple in the Rust Belt, and it gets much harder when A sits 100 feet up and B is solid ground. Two new fall mitigation items let skilled Raiders defy gravity, provided they stay focused.

# NEW EVENT: LAST RESORT

The **Last Resort** event runs until **May 25** and converts your XP into Merits as you play on any map. For extra Merits, track down miniature **Ship Models** scattered across the world, each worth a different amount depending on rarity. Collect enough Merits to unlock three pages of rewards, including the **Junior Outfit**, the **Hydrologist** backpack, the **Hose** attachment, the **Brass Faucet** charm, new emotes, and a total of **250 Raider Tokens**.

# NEW RAIDER PROJECT: AVIAN ALARM

This new Raider project has you building a makeshift security system that detects tremors and shifts in the atmosphere. Place cages at buoys along the Riven Tides coastline to catch birds for the **Avian Alarm**. Complete all five stages to earn the **Dockmaster's Detector** (needed for Beachcombing), **Gel Patches**, the **Bird House** backpack attachment, the **Fist In Air** emote, and a total of **250 Raider Tokens**.

# NEW COSMETICS

Riven Tides delivers a wave of new cosmetics, beginning with two sets available at launch. The **Solare Set** wraps you in ceremonial layers and woven fabrics, suited to those who treat sunrise like a ritual. The **Rachetta Set** skips subtlety entirely, with bold colors and an athletic cut built for Raiders who trust speed over stealth and have no interest in camouflage.

More sets will follow throughout May. The **Corsaro Set** dresses the techno-captain of the high seas, featuring a robotic arm and a spring-operated leg. The **Castaway Set** suits the lone wolf who has abandoned rank and allegiance, self-reliant and unpredictable. Finally, the **Sandveil Set** stays patient and pale, made for long stretches through dust and heat where knowing when to hold still matters as much as knowing when to strike.

See you beachside, Raiders.
